<thought>Based on the molecular ion (m/z 141.115, corresponding to a neutral mass of ~140 Da) and the 13C NMR data (carbonyl at 167 ppm, two sp² carbons at 144 and 130 ppm, a pair of equivalent aliphatic carbons at 34.5 ppm, and three distinct methyl carbons between 19–23 ppm), the most plausible formula is C₈H₁₂O₂ (DBE = 3). This fits an α,β‑unsaturated ester with a butyl alkoxy group, giving the structure butyl methacrylate. Its SMILES representation is “C=C(C)C(=O)OCCCC”.</thought>
<final_answer>C=C(C)C(=O)OCCCC</final_answer>
